methods.MISIM2010_direct: Wang2010 disease DAG and symmetric best-match averaging, delta0.5, adapted from miRNA-miRNA to miRNA-gene profiles
methods.Jaccard_similarity: Raw normalized disease-name set intersection divided by union, higher predicts observed P
methods.Jaccard_mapped: Intersection divided by union of the unique exact-MeSH descriptor sets used by MISIM; abstain on empty mapped endpoints.

mapping: Exact NFKC/lowercase/whitespace MeSH Category C names. No fuzzy aliases. Unmapped names omitted. Empty mapped endpoint means abstention/NaN.
primary_comparison: Both complete-profile trained encoders, MISIM and explicit raw/mapped Jaccard scores on identical MeSH-covered candidates. Their disease-information scopes are stated separately.
full_cohort: Both complete-profile miRTarDS encoders and raw-name Jaccard on all test candidates. MISIM missing scores are not imputed.

mesh.snapshot_version: Version/date not recorded in the supplied CSV. Snapshot identified by SHA256; do not infer a MeSH release year.

model_selection: Frozen miRTarDS predictor selected on earlier BioLORD development splits. No baseline fitting or threshold tuning.
metrics: Class-balanced AP from tie-aware average precision with each class total mass0.5. Report raw AP and ROC-AUC separately.
selection_timing: The data0/1/2 release subset was chosen after review of five exploratory resplits. Current classifier training seeds are0/1/2 for both primary encoders.
secondary_matched_information: results/secondary/matched_information: all three methods use the identical restricted MeSH descriptor sets; miRTarDS is retrained.
